{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kubaz Insect''' was a statue, standing a third of a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] high and sculpted from a single [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]]-fusion crystal. It was in the collection of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Rock'co]] until it was stolen by the [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] [[Sam]] and [[Lauren]].
